# Feature Completion Backlog

**Derived from:** the code-verified feature audit (`PLATFORM-OVERVIEW.md` §1b, 2026-07-18).
**Scope:** the 11 partial + 1 mislabeled features and the 6 cross-cutting gaps. This is a
**feature-completion / hardening** initiative — distinct from the RMD remediation program (which
fixed security/data/quality of what already worked).

> ✅ **Sprint 1 DONE (PR #87, `e3ec463`):** FC-01 (encrypt creds) · FC-02 (on-demand PDF gen) · FC-03 (wire sentiment pipeline) — closed gaps #1, #2, #5.
>
> ✅ **Sprint 2 DONE:** FC-04 (CRM 360 card) · FC-05 (mount PatternDashboard) · FC-06 (employee real-time) · FC-07 (Daily Brief page) · FC-08 (Ask-Marketing chat) — closed gap #3, #4.
>
> ✅ **Sprint 3:** FC-09 (deliver AI reply to customer, opt-in gated) · FC-12 (relabel FEAT-022 = Express accounting export, not delivery).

**Prioritized by:** security first → highest leverage (one fix unblocks several features) → then
effort (cheapest, most-visible wins next). Effort legend: **S** ≤1 day · **M** 2–4 days ·
**L** ≥1 week · **XL** multi-week/own initiative.

---

## Recommended first sprint

**FC-01 → FC-02 → FC-03** (security + the two high-leverage unblocks). Roughly one focused week:
- closes the plaintext-credential hole,
- makes every "download PDF" surface actually work (2 features at once),
- turns on the sentiment-analysis pipeline that currently produces no data.

Then P2 (FC-04…FC-08) is a fast, satisfying batch — all backend already exists, so it's pure UI
wiring with immediate visible payoff. P3 is where the genuinely new build work (backfill, settings,
mobile) and the one product decision (FEAT-022) live.

## Notes
- **Data-model dependency:** FC-11's billing history needs a tenant-subscription-billing model that
  doesn't exist yet (why RMD-E07 was descoped). Design that model before building the UI.
- **Leverage math:** FC-02 fixes 2 features; FC-03 unblocks the whole sentiment pipeline (FEAT-018
  + feeds 019). P0+P1 = 3 tickets that clear a disproportionate share of the gap list.
- Cross-reference: `docs/PLATFORM-OVERVIEW.md` §1 (per-feature status) + §1b (gaps),
  `docs/remediation/RMD-PROGRAM-REPORT.md` (what the remediation program already covered).
